title: COST OF LIVING.
text: For 1932–33, for the whole of Scotland, Poor Law relief was £4,676,000, but in 1934–35, during this decrease of the registered unemployed, we had an increase of more than £2,000,000 for poor relief.

I am submitting these figures to show that this continued repeating of a decline of registered unemployed, knowing all the time that they have been placed on Poor Law relief, is not only dishonest but is a practice which is not worthy of the House of Commons nor of British politics.
